channel.description: Essays, notes and theories on any subject, written by nobody in particular.

item.title: Turkic Numerals and Pronouns
item.description: Turkic numerals and pronouns compared syllable by syllable, with the sound shifts behind them and a note on Uralic and Basque.

item.title: Nostratic v2.0: Pronouns
item.description: Personal and interrogative pronouns, from “I” and “they” to “who” and “what”, across eight language families, with possible sound paths.

item.title: Nostratic v2.0: Numbers
item.description: Cognate sets for the numerals 1–7 and 10 across eight language families, with possible sound paths and the subtractive 8 and 9.
